mapper.select: select t.*,( SELECT b.filling_ln_id FROM jc_fund_filling_ln b WHERE b.filling_id = #{refFillingId} AND b.FILL_ITEM_CODE = t.ITEM_CODE AND substring_index(b.unit_code, '1', 1) = ( SELECT u.unit_code FROM jc_fund_filling tt, fnd_org_unit u WHERE tt.filling_id = #{fillingId} AND tt.unit_id = u.unit_id ) )filling_ln_id_nor FROM jc_fund_filling_req_detail t WHERE t.filling_id = #{fillingId} and t.item_code in ('PRINCIPAL','INTEREST','LEGAL_FEE','DEPOSIT','LOAN_DELIVERY')

select t.*, (select p.project_name from prj_project p where p.project_id = t.project_id)project_name, (select p.project_number from prj_project p where p.project_id = t.project_id)project_id_n, t.bank_id, (SELECT a.bank_branch_name FROM csh_bank_account a WHERE a.bank_account_id = t.bank_id) bank_account_id_n, (SELECT a.bank_account_num FROM csh_bank_account a WHERE a.bank_account_id = t.bank_id) bank_account_num, (SELECT a.bank_account_name FROM csh_bank_account a WHERE a.bank_account_id = t.bank_id) bank_account_name, (SELECT a.bank_type_new FROM csh_bank_account a WHERE a.bank_account_id = t.bank_id) bank_type_new_n from jc_fund_filling_req_detail t where t.FILLING_LN_ID = #{fillingLnId} and t.item = #{fillItem}

SELECT p.PROJECT_ID, p.project_number AS PROJECT_ID_N, p.project_number, p.project_name, t.CONTRACT_ID, t.CONTRACT_NAME, t.CONTRACT_NUMBER, c.DUE_DATE, ( CASE #{itemCode} WHEN 'PRINCIPAL' THEN c.PRINCIPAL WHEN 'INTEREST' THEN c.INTEREST WHEN 'LEGAL_FEE' THEN c.DUE_AMOUNT ELSE c.DUE_AMOUNT END ) DUE_AMOUNT, p.bank_account_id, (SELECT a.bank_branch_name FROM csh_bank_account a WHERE a.bank_account_id = p.bank_account_id) bank_id_n, (SELECT a.bank_account_num FROM csh_bank_account a WHERE a.bank_account_id = p.bank_account_id) bank_account_num, (SELECT a.bank_account_name FROM csh_bank_account a WHERE a.bank_account_id = p.bank_account_id) bank_account_name, (SELECT a.bank_type_new FROM csh_bank_account a WHERE a.bank_account_id = p.bank_account_id) bank_type_new_n FROM con_contract t, con_contract_cashflow c, prj_project p WHERE t.DATA_CLASS = 'NORMAL' and t.contract_status in ('INCEPT','ET','TERMINATE') AND c.cf_item = (case #{itemCode} when 'PRINCIPAL' then 1 when 'INTEREST' then 1 when 'LEGAL_FEE' then 3 else 51 end) AND t.CONTRACT_ID = c.CONTRACT_ID AND t.project_id = p.PROJECT_ID AND c.cf_status = 'RELEASE' AND c.due_date BETWEEN to_date(CONCAT(#{fundType}, '-01'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND last_day(to_date(CONCAT(#{fundType}, '-31'),'yyyy-mm')) and p.host_unit_id = #{hostUnitId}

SELECT p.PROJECT_ID, p.project_number AS PROJECT_ID_N, p.project_number, p.project_name, t.CONTRACT_ID, t.CONTRACT_NAME, t.CONTRACT_NUMBER, c.DUE_DATE, ( CASE #{itemCode} WHEN 'PRINCIPAL' THEN c.PRINCIPAL WHEN 'INTEREST' THEN c.INTEREST WHEN 'LEGAL_FEE' THEN c.DUE_AMOUNT ELSE c.DUE_AMOUNT END ) DUE_AMOUNT, p.bank_account_id, (SELECT a.bank_branch_name FROM csh_bank_account a WHERE a.bank_account_id = p.bank_account_id) bank_id_n, (SELECT a.bank_account_num FROM csh_bank_account a WHERE a.bank_account_id = p.bank_account_id) bank_account_num, (SELECT a.bank_account_name FROM csh_bank_account a WHERE a.bank_account_id = p.bank_account_id) bank_account_name, (SELECT a.bank_type_new FROM csh_bank_account a WHERE a.bank_account_id = p.bank_account_id) bank_type_new_n FROM con_contract t, con_contract_cashflow c, prj_project p WHERE t.DATA_CLASS = 'NORMAL' and t.contract_status in ('INCEPT','ET','TERMINATE') AND c.cf_item = (case #{itemCode} when 'PRINCIPAL' then 1 when 'INTEREST' then 1 when 'LEGAL_FEE' then 3 else 51 end) AND t.CONTRACT_ID = c.CONTRACT_ID AND t.project_id = p.PROJECT_ID AND c.cf_status = 'RELEASE' AND c.due_date = to_date(#{fundType},'YYYY-MM-DD') and p.host_unit_id = #{hostUnitId}

t.filling_id = #{fillingId} and t.fund_type = #{fundType} and t.item_code in('PRINCIPAL','INTEREST','LEGAL_FEE','DEPOSIT') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM csh_bank_account cb WHERE cb.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y' AND cb.bank_account_id = t.bank_id AND cb.BANK_TYPE_NEW = 'USED_ACCOUNT' AND cb.company_id = 248 )
